lead.claim: Combined VR + AR feedback may offer the broadest acute gait improvements for stroke.
lead.context: Why this matters: This randomized crossover trial looked at how virtual and augmented reality feedback during robotic gait training affected muscle activation and limb loading in chronic hemiparetic stroke.

supporting.claim: Are PTs driving true whole-system integration for chronic MSK conditions?
supporting.context: Why this matters: A scoping review explored integrated care approaches for chronic musculoskeletal disorders, noting physiotherapist involvement but limited overall system integration.

supporting.claim: Stroke-affected limbs may have reduced venous pump capacity and refilling time.
supporting.context: Why this matters: This retrospective cross-sectional study examined venous flow dynamics in the lower extremities of individuals with post-stroke hemiparesis.

supporting.claim: Despite perceived need, many PTs face barriers to instrumented gait assessment.
supporting.context: Why this matters: A survey investigated current clinical practice and obstacles to using instrumented gait assessment in stroke rehabilitation among Japanese physiotherapists.
